definitions.explanation: The current price at which a share of stock is traded on the stock market.

examples.japanese: {株価|かぶか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{急落|きゅうらく}した→急落：09399_kyuuraku⟧。
⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{株価|かぶか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
{株価|かぶか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上昇|じょうしょう}して→上昇する：21681_joushousuru⟧⟦{利益|りえき}→利益：03673_rieki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: I made a profit because the stock price rose.

notes:
{株価|かぶか} is the price of a single share of stock on the market. A compound of ⟦{株|かぶ}→株：02592_kabu⟧ (stock) + ⟦{価|か}→価：noentry⟧ (price). Frequently appears in news and financial reporting.
